written: 2026-11-15, before the strict gate was implemented and before any comparison result

strict.call: strict_mean_gate(d, support=SUPPORT, support_basis='synthetic generator support', alpha=0.05, n_expected=n)

report_only_stubs: In the frozen module, paired_bootstrap_ci and paired_permutation_p (computed alongside the decision, never read by it) are replaced by NaN-returning constants for speed. Decision neutrality is re-checked on probe cells and recorded in the results.
seed_rule: seed = 20261115 + 1000*n_values.index(n) + 10*dist_order.index(dist); rng = random.Random(seed); the reps bands of size n are drawn in sequence, element by element; the SAME bands are fed to every gate. The first seven distributions and the first five n values keep the seeds of Table 7's default configuration, so frozen_default must reproduce those 35 counts exactly.

criteria.C1_validity: In every bounded null cell (unif0, skew0, skewc0, rademacher, skew_mild; all n), the strict gate's CONFIRMED count k of R has a Wilson 95% lower bound <= 0.05. A violation in any cell means the repair is reported as invalid.
criteria.C2_gaussian_null: In every gauss0 cell, the same criterion, counting INVALID_INPUT as not confirmed; INVALID_INPUT is reported separately.
criteria.C3_capacity: Every band with n <= 7 whose values are valid (all finite and inside the support) gets UNATTAINABLE from the strict gate (all supports in this protocol are symmetric); no band with n >= 8 gets UNATTAINABLE. Bands with an invalid value get INVALID_INPUT whatever n is.
criteria.C4_equivalence: On every band where the frozen gate used its declared-support branch (gate == 'apriori_betting'), the strict e-value equals the frozen e_apriori (relative difference <= 1e-12, or both at or above the frozen 1e6 cap) and the confirmations agree. Any disagreement is reported and explained before any claim is made.
criteria.C5_edge_cases: Every frozen route listed in REPAIR_CONTRACT.md section 5 returns a non-CONFIRMED strict status; E03, E19 and E20 return CONFIRMED.
criteria.C6_continuity: frozen_default reproduces the 35 default-configuration counts of Table 7 exactly.
criteria.power_reporting: Power is descriptive. The paper may say the strict gate has power in a cell only where the Wilson 95% lower bound of its confirmation rate is >= 0.5; elsewhere it reports abstention or low power.
criteria.abstention_reporting: Abstentions (UNATTAINABLE, NO_JUSTIFIED_SUPPORT, INCOMPLETE, EMPTY) and invalid outcomes (INVALID_INPUT, INVALID_SUPPORT) are counted separately from NOT_CONFIRMED and from each other.

run_rule: One run of the whole protocol. No change to c, the threshold, the supports, the distributions, n or the reps after results are seen. If the code must change after results (a bug), the change and its reason are appended to 'amendments' and every cell is rerun.
